purpose: Produce verified word timings while preserving exactly what each speaker actually said.
hard_gates: Proper nouns, numbers, products and consequential claims require human verification.
soft_gates: Word timing and diarisation confidence should support precise editorial cuts.

failure.fallback: Use available captions for discovery only and block approval until shortlisted wording is verified.

regression_cases: Caption cleanup never adds a word absent from the verified transcript.
Speaker uncertainty cannot silently assign a guest quote to Krish.
